pages.text: $(italic)Pure melee investment. Best for Berserker, Vanguard, Samurai and Paladin.$()$(br2)Every node is attribute-based, so it applies immediately and needs no KubeJS.

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Melee Damage$(): the core trunk. It raises base melee damage through Pufferfish's Attributes melee_damage attribute.$(br2)$(bold)Sword Mastery / Axe Mastery$(): Branch 1 or 2, an exclusive choice. Sword adds crit chance, Axe armor shred.$(br2)$(bold)Attack Speed$(): a mid-trunk node that raises the attack speed attribute. With the Orc racial it gives an extreme attack rate.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Tamed Damage / Tamed Resistance$(): dedicated nodes for summoner builds that increase damage dealt by and to your tamed and summoned entities.$(br2)$(bold)Warfare Capstone$(): $(bold)Berserker's Will$(), which needs 35+ Warfare nodes. Each kill gives +5% damage for 10s, stacking 5x.
